evals.prompt: Add a rule that flags WebView.setSavePassword(true).
evals.expected_output: Adds a RULES entry with suffixes for .kt/.java covering Java and Kotlin syntax, maps it in RULE_MASVS, adds/extends a knowledge note, writes positive and negative tests, runs pytest and --check-knowledge, and updates README.

evals.prompt: ANDROID-HTTP-URL is flagging http://www.example.com in a KDoc comment. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: Writes a failing negative test reproducing the false positive first, then narrows the pattern without renaming the rule ID, and keeps existing positive tests passing.

evals.prompt: Add a rule that connects to the car over ADB and checks if the HVAC service accepts commands.
evals.expected_output: Declines to add a dynamic/device-interacting rule; explains rules must stay static and offline, and offers a static manifest/permission check plus a manual emulator-only checklist item instead.
